job.prompt: Create a realistic photograph-style image of a mid-sized Taiwanese export manufacturer's sales office. A business professional in smart-casual attire sits at a clean desk, looking at their laptop screen which shows a basic company website with small product thumbnails. On the desk: a few printed product catalogs with industrial product photos on covers, international trade show visitor badges with lanyards, scattered business cards from overseas clients, and a coffee mug. The scene subtly conveys 'good products but underperforming digital presence' — the person looks thoughtful, not frustrated. Professional natural office lighting through a window, modern but modest office furniture, warm neutral tones. No cinematic effects, no dramatic lighting. Authentic mid-sized manufacturing company atmosphere. 16:9 aspect ratio.
